nsights More items SWE-smith Harbor packages expose the fix through git history in the agent container #10212 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Open Open SWE-smith Harbor packages expose the fix through git history in the agent container #10212 Copy link Labels agent-generated Automated failure tracking Automated failure tracking Description karansag opened on Oct 16, 2026 Issue body actions The SWE-smith Harbor task packages in DCAgent/swesmith-sandboxes-with_tests-oracle_verified_120s (and the same layout in mlfoundations-dev/swesmith-sandboxes-with_tests ) leave the repository's full git history in the agent's container. The image built from environment/Dockerfile keeps a local main branch with the unbroken code and about 944 other branches, so the agent can print the fix with git diff HEAD main -- <package> or git show main:<file> . /tests and /solution are correctly absent from the image. Reproduce: build swesmith-00003 's environment/Dockerfile from the package, run it with no network, then git log --oneline (three commits: Initial commit, Bug Patch, Remove F2P Tests), git branch -a (944 branches including main ), git diff HEAD main -- oauthlib (the exact fix).
